title: Test desired-state authority in the nominated OverlayKit Git boundary

claims.statement: The human authorization permits only local offline read-only Git inspection and local ignored evidence writes; it prohibits network access, live host observation, Docker, USB or hidraw access, signals, restart, installation, configuration, ADR, specification or production-policy creation, raw publication, commit, push, and merge.
claims.evidence: Exact H-048 human authorization accepted on 2026-07-27.

claims.statement: A repository-qualified, content-addressed inventory of both nominated main trees, strict archive expansion, explicit indirection review, and an independent eight-predicate classifier is the smallest offline Slice that can test the nominated authority question without designing or exercising a reconciler.
claims.evidence: D³ reorder accepted by the principal, ADR-0001 evidence-before-decision rule, and the fail-closed source-closure lessons preserved by H-047.

claims.statement: H-048: within the exact human-nominated OverlayKit Git boundary there exists at least one current, explicit, unambiguous, and fully linked desired-state chain rooted in effective accepted production authority that binds the exact Companion image to the SPEC-0001 Linux production-host role with deployment presence and cardinality, a repository-declared lifecycle owner, a reconciler mechanism, an absence-to-convergence rule, and complete link closure.
claims.evidence: This is the refutable positive-existence hypothesis; all eight predicates are required and historical evidence, laboratory resources, proposed records, implementation code alone, inferred proximity, and sources outside the nominated boundary cannot satisfy it.

claims.statement: The accepted repo-set and ref-set digests cannot be independently admitted until their exact byte preimages and canonicalization algorithms are available or the human principal nominates a new explicit content-addressed manifest.
claims.evidence: A digest without its preimage cannot establish set membership, ordering, field selection, or completeness; substituting a newly invented serialization would change the accepted boundary.

claims.statement: The final H-048 harness source-set digest, candidate review-map digest, independent verification result, and canonical outcome remain unknown until the local source closure is frozen and executed twice.
claims.evidence: Any change to CHG-0024, the subject lock, producer, schema, review map, tests, or verifier changes the local no-commit source closure.

claims.statement: Inaccessible organization variables and secrets, unreported private sources, wikis, issues, projects, deleted refs, runbooks, CMDB, host configuration, current host state, external operational ownership, intent, compliance, drift, cause, and remedy remain outside the accepted H-048 boundary.
claims.evidence: The human principal explicitly preserved these surfaces as out of scope and unknown; no H-048 outcome may generalize beyond the nominated Git boundary.

claims.statement: Any authority to install, configure, start, stop, restart, signal, reconcile, retry, publish, create an ADR, change a product specification, or otherwise mutate production remains unknown pending a separate governed human transition.
claims.evidence: CHG-0024 is proposed and non-authorizing; every valid H-048 outcome is fixed to authority none and action null.

successCriteria.statement: The precontract records the exact human-nominated repo-set digest, both repository identities, commits, trees, entry counts, tree-manifest digests, ref-set digests, prohibited surfaces, and external unknowns without substituting local observations for accepted anchors.
successCriteria.verification: Strict subject-lock schema, exact comparison with CHG-0024 and the accepted motion, and independent verifier constants.

successCriteria.statement: Each main subject is independently reconstructed only from its exact Git object database by commit, tree, NUL-safe ls-tree stream, repository-qualified path, mode, OID, length, and SHA-256; every cat-file payload must independently reproduce its ls-tree Git blob OID, and all 679 entries are covered exactly once.
successCriteria.verification: Read-only git rev-parse, ls-tree, and cat-file under an exact command allowlist with no lazy fetch or optional locks; independent Git blob framing plus hostile omission, duplicate, path-collision, substituted blob, mode, OID, tree, count, and digest tests.

successCriteria.statement: Accepted repo-set and ref-set anchors are admitted only from their exact declared byte preimages and canonicalization rules; absent preimages force H-048 inconclusive with reason accepted-source-anchor-opaque, while a present hash mismatch is invalid evidence before semantic classification.
successCriteria.verification: Preflight outcome matrix and hostile tests for absent, malformed, reordered, truncated, substituted, and digest-mismatched set manifests.

successCriteria.statement: Repository identity is part of every path, citation, archive virtual route, atom, edge, and digest frame so the 76 cross-repository relative-path collisions cannot alias sources.
successCriteria.verification: Repo-qualified uniqueness checks and hostile fixtures that substitute the same relative path, OID, or blob hash from the other repository.

successCriteria.statement: Every tracked archive is expanded in-process under one exact strict global policy; traversal, absolute or duplicate routes, links, unsupported members, extension or signature mismatch, trailing bytes, nested-depth or resource-budget excess, and opaque relied-upon content force invalid or inconclusive evidence.
successCriteria.verification: Exact archive root-set comparison, content-addressed closure receipts, shared global budgets, and inherited H-047 plus H-048 repository-namespace hostile tests.

successCriteria.statement: A desired-state chain is assembled only from externally human-accepted typed contributions that share one deployment key proven by the same exact UTF-8 byte span in every cited source; each contribution binds a repository, exact subject commit, source kind, path, SHA-256, predicate, supports-or-contradicts disposition, and byte-span receipt. All eight predicates require exactly one uncontradicted support, and explicit link closure additionally requires an exact atomic cross-repository repo-plus-commit receipt owned by that contribution's source.
successCriteria.verification: Typed-chain tests for one complete chain, exact source-byte binding, no Cartesian mixing across bindings, partial chains, duplicate supports, contradictions, source-anchor swaps, inferred or borrowed links, historical identities, and multiple independent chains.

successCriteria.statement: Outcome precedence is fail closed: invalid source admission is rejected; any opaque, omitted, ambiguous, conflicting, unresolved, or unreviewed source or potentially semantic relationship inside the nominated boundary makes H-048 inconclusive. Complete tree and archive inventory closes local content targets, while every relationship capable of contributing to a chain must either have typed source-byte evidence or be covered by an externally content-addressed human acceptance of the complete default indirection dismissal. That acceptance must bind the exact non-circular review-universe preimage containing the policy, all source receipts, all default-candidate identities, and every indirection receipt. A literal target outside the nominated boundary is preserved as a terminal excluded receipt and is never fetched or treated as a dependency; a GitHub pull-request target remains unresolved because it was not excluded by the human motion. Only complete zero-chain coverage refutes H-048 and only one or more complete chains with zero unknowns support it.
successCriteria.verification: Strict schema cross-field invariants, exact review-universe artifact reconstruction, producer and verifier parity, and hostile outcome-matrix tests.

successCriteria.statement: The independent verifier reconstructs subject identities, source maps, archive closures, content-addressed human-review admission, typed predicates, candidate chains, outcome, authority, and the exact claim boundary without importing the producer or classifier or trusting producer-supplied candidate or outcome fields. The producer and verifier may share only the source-closed strict low-level archive decoder.
successCriteria.verification: Static import-boundary test, independent semantic reconstruction above the captured archive decoder, byte comparison, and adversarial artifact mutation tests.

successCriteria.statement: Because commit is prohibited, the H-048 harness uses an explicit local unsigned content-addressed source closure with exact repo-qualified path, mode, length, and SHA-256; absence of a source signature is represented honestly and never weakened into signed evidence. The writer is pinned to the repository-local artifacts/h048 boundary, and the exact .gitignore bytes plus its artifacts/ rule are part of the source closure.
successCriteria.verification: Canonical local source manifest, pinned artifact root, captured ignore-rule invariant, immutable snapshot directory modes 0700/0600, no symlinks, exclusive writes, double source snapshots, and exact source-set digest comparison.

successCriteria.statement: Two local producer runs yield byte-identical semantic evidence and the independent verifier reproduces their source maps, candidate maps, outcome, and semantic digest.
successCriteria.verification: Separate ignored run directories, byte and SHA-256 comparison, independent verification outputs, and source stability checks.

successCriteria.statement: The harness executes with no network and only exact read-only Git commands plus writes pinned to the repository-local ignored artifacts/h048 boundary; it performs no Docker, USB, procfs, sysfs, devfs, systemd, hidraw, signal, lifecycle, installation, configuration, publication, or production access.
successCriteria.verification: Zero-inheritance subprocess environment, exact executable and argument allowlist, source inspection, hostile command tests, capability receipt, and repository diff.

successCriteria.statement: No accepted ADR, accepted specification, implemented change, profile, compiled plan, product code, production configuration, or prior H-047 source is edited; only CHG-0024, its H-048 lab sources, and the deterministically regenerated manifest may change.
successCriteria.verification: Base-ref byte comparison, governance compiler output, plan/profile hash identity, source allowlist, and repository diff.

successCriteria.statement: Governance, focused H-048 tests, repository quality checks, and build gates pass before local evidence is handed to the human principal.
successCriteria.verification: npm run governance:verify, npm run governance:check, pinned Node 22.20.0 focused tests, npm run check with npm_config_offline=true, and npm run build.
